```yaml
name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.22'

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        run: |
          cd tests/e2e
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Build Tavern frontend
        run: |
          cd tavern-frontend
          npm ci
          npm run build

      - name: Build Tavern server
        run: |
          cargo build --release

      - name: Start Tavern server
        run: |
          cargo run --release --bin tavern-server &
          echo $! > tavern_server_pid.txt
          # Wait until the server is ready
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:8080/health >/dev/null; then
              echo "Tavern server is ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Retrieve server public key
        id: get_key
        run: |
          KEY=$(curl -s http://localhost:8080/public-key)
          echo "public_key=$KEY" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build Imixv2 agent
        run: |
          go build -o imixv2 ./cmd/imixv2

      - name: Start Imixv2 agent
        run: |
          ./imixv2 --key "${{ steps.get_key.outputs.public_key }}" &
          echo $! > imixv2_pid.txt

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: |
          cd tests/e2e
          npx playwright test

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f tavern_server_pid.txt ]; then
            kill $(cat tavern_server_pid.txt) || true
          fi
          if [ -f imixv2_pid.txt ]; then
            kill $(cat imixv2_pid.txt) || true
          fi
```
